# Config: Hyprland.look

> **Reader:** `HyprlandConfig` (`config/HyprlandConfig.qml`)
> **Schema:** `config/json/config.schema.json` → `properties.Hyprland` · category Hyprland
> **Part of:** [Hyprland](Hyprland.md)

Each setting: `path` · type = default · enum/range/unit; then title: description; annotations; `read:` the reader member(s) (exact unless marked) and `in:` the files that use them.

### `Hyprland.look`

- **`Hyprland.look`** · object
  - Window look: Hyprland settings that make windows match axiom, in every mode. While on, they win over your own Hyprland config, and they come along when you share or import a config.
  - x-scope="look"
- **`Hyprland.look.borders`** · boolean = false
  - Themed borders: Window borders in theme colors.
  - read: `HyprlandConfig.look` (whole) · in: `config/HyprlandConfig.qml`
- **`Hyprland.look.shape`** · boolean = false
  - Match axiom's shape: Window corners and border width follow Look & Feel → Shape.
  - read: `HyprlandConfig.look` (whole) · in: `services/HyprlandConfigManager.qml`
- **`Hyprland.look.gaps`** · boolean = false
  - Set window gaps: Floating bars and detached surfaces set to Automatic keep these gaps too.
  - read: `HyprlandConfig.look` (whole) · in: `config/HyprlandConfig.qml`
- **`Hyprland.look.gapsIn`** · integer = 3 · 0–50 · px
  - Gaps between windows
  - x-control="stepper", x-showIf={"gaps":true}
  - read: `HyprlandConfig.look` (whole) · in: `config/HyprlandConfig.qml`
- **`Hyprland.look.gapsOut`** · integer = 6 · 0–100 · px
  - Gaps to the edges
  - x-control="stepper", x-showIf={"gaps":true}
  - read: `HyprlandConfig.look` (whole) · in: `config/HyprlandConfig.qml`
- **`Hyprland.look.blur`** · boolean = false
  - Set Hyprland's blur: Hyprland has one blur, for windows and axiom's translucent surfaces alike. Off, your own Hyprland config's applies.
  - x-group="Blur"
  - read: `HyprlandConfig.look` (whole) · in: `components/views/settings/TranslucencyStatus.qml`, `services/HyprlandConfigManager.qml`
- **`Hyprland.look.windowBlur`** · boolean = true
  - Blur transparent windows: Off, only axiom's surfaces blur (Look & Feel → Translucency).
  - x-group="Blur", x-showIf={"blur":true}, x-hypr="decoration.blur.enabled", x-hyprIf="blur"
  - read: `HyprlandConfig.look` (whole) · in: `config/HyprlandConfig.qml`
- **`Hyprland.look.blurSize`** · integer = 4 · 1–20
  - Blur size
  - x-control="stepper", x-group="Blur", x-showIf={"blur":true}, x-hypr="decoration.blur.size", x-hyprIf="blur"
  - read: `HyprlandConfig.look` (whole) · in: `config/HyprlandConfig.qml`
- **`Hyprland.look.blurPasses`** · integer = 3 · 1–6
  - Blur passes
  - x-group="Blur", x-showIf={"blur":true}, x-hypr="decoration.blur.passes", x-hyprIf="blur"
  - read: `HyprlandConfig.look` (whole) · in: `config/HyprlandConfig.qml`
- **`Hyprland.look.blurXray`** · boolean = true
  - See-through blur: Floating windows blur only the wallpaper, not the windows under them. Cheaper.
  - x-group="Blur", x-showIf={"blur":true,"windowBlur":true}, x-hypr="decoration.blur.xray", x-hyprIf="blur"
  - read: `HyprlandConfig.look` (whole) · in: `config/HyprlandConfig.qml`
- **`Hyprland.look.blurIgnoreOpacity`** · boolean = true
  - Full blur behind any transparency
  - x-group="Blur", x-showIf={"blur":true,"windowBlur":true}, x-hypr="decoration.blur.ignore_opacity", x-hyprIf="blur"
  - read: `HyprlandConfig.look` (whole) · in: `config/HyprlandConfig.qml`
- **`Hyprland.look.blurNewOptimizations`** · boolean = true
  - Blur optimizations
  - x-group="Blur", x-showIf={"blur":true}, x-hypr="decoration.blur.new_optimizations", x-hyprIf="blur"

- **`Hyprland.look.blurNoise`** · integer = 12 · 0–1000 · ‰

- **`Hyprland.look.blurContrast`** · integer = 89 · 0–200 · %
  - Contrast
  - x-group="Blur", x-showIf={"blur":true}, x-hypr="decoration.blur.contrast", x-hyprScale=0.01, x-hyprIf="blur"
  - read: `HyprlandConfig.look` (whole) · in: `config/HyprlandConfig.qml`
- **`Hyprland.look.blurVibrancy`** · integer = 17 · 0–100 · %

- **`Hyprland.look.blurPopups`** · boolean = false
  - Blur menus and popups
